Title: Monthly Windows Server OS Security Patching - Nov 2024
Description: Apply Microsoft November 2024 cumulative security updates to NEX-DC01 (Domain Controller) and NEX-FS01 (File Server).
RiskAssessment: Low risk. Standard pre-approved monthly maintenance. Failover and backups completed prior to update window.
BackoutPlan: Revert to hypervisor snapshot taken at 22:30 prior to patching initiation. Rollback time estimated at 20 minutes.
TestPlan: 1. Verify DC active directory replication health using repadmin /replsummary. 2. Verify DNS resolution and SMB file share accessibility from test client.
Result: Success. Both servers patched and rebooted sequentially. Verification checks passed with zero errors.

Title: GlobalProtect Gateway MTU Adjustment and PMTUD Enablement
Description: Adjust Palo Alto firewall GlobalProtect gateway MTU to 1400 and enable Path MTU Discovery to permanently resolve remote worker VPN disconnection issues identified in PRB0001.
RiskAssessment: Medium risk. Affects all connected remote VPN tunnels during brief firewall policy commit (approx 60-90 seconds). Scheduled outside business hours.
BackoutPlan: Revert firewall configuration commit to running snapshot #20241115-STABLE via Palo Alto GUI or CLI. Rollback time: 5 minutes.
TestPlan: 1. Connect 3 remote test laptops over cellular hotspot and home broadband. 2. Run continuous 1400-byte ICMP ping and 1GB file transfer. 3. Monitor for 30 minutes for tunnel dropouts.
Result: Pending implementation in scheduled maintenance window.

Title: Emergency Replacement of Core Switch SFP+ Transceiver
Description: Replace failing 10G SFP+ uplink module on Core Switch SW-CORE-01 linking to MDF Distribution Switch following intermittent link flaps causing building-wide packet loss.
RiskAssessment: High risk due to execution during business hours
BackoutPlan: but necessary to arrest severe degradation affecting production systems (INC0015 / PRB0003).
TestPlan: Hot-swap spare transceiver back to secondary backup port and force spanning-tree uplink failover. Rollback time: 3 minutes.
Result: 1. Inspect physical link status and optic light levels using show interfaces transceiver. 2. Validate ping packet loss <0.1% over 500 packets across VLANs.
column16: Success. Transceiver replaced at 11:45. Link stabilized immediately. Error counters cleared and zero packet loss observed.
